pages.text: Health 220, Armor 10, Toughness 2, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Attack 20, Speed 0.3.$(br)An iron warden from a prison in another dimension, built for hunting down escapees - and to a wizard who knows how to build war machines, just another loyal guard. Since chasing fugitives is what it does, you built it a prison that moves, one that can hold whatever it catches and hand it to you.
Right-click the central $(l)Prison Steel Block$() with a $(l)Vitality Core$().

Right-click the Prison Golem with a Waystone that has recorded the coordinates of a mobile prison and it will bind that prison; one golem can be bound to several prisons.$(br)Creatures the golem defeats have a chance to be taken prisoner and teleported into the mobile prison - a first-rate source of labour that is hard to come by.
You can right-click your Prison Golem while holding a Prison Steel Block to restore its health.
